translation.name: Raraŋ Aetaniacna Kam Wembaŋ Laŋ
translation.englishName: New Testament in Mborena Kam language

content: Na ganna ande, Iesus Karaisna nicar ŋgamrirta wiwit.

content.text: Na Iesus Karaisa ma Dewitna wiwitnan,
na Iakopa ma Iudaapa mana laiplacarta aet.
Na Iudana nuocniŋa Peresapa Sera, na maniŋna aemma Tamar.
Na Salmon ma Boasna aet, na mana aemma Reap,
na Boasa ma Obetna aet, na mana aemma Rut,
na Iesi tikca ma gagrirta ramoot paŋan Dewitna aet.

content: Na Dewitta ma Solomonna aet, na Solomonna aemma, outta ma Uraia laŋgoca eacrina.

content.text: Na Iosaia ma Iekoiakinapa mana laiplacarta aet, na an kɨdrɨkca Babilonnanda, Israelnanap ruŋga minmo tuomb naaŋgɨca Babilonna tɨkrina.

content: Karica mina taŋga Babilonna inikca mbukca, anna eacatna nicarta wiwitta, gade,

content.text: Na Iakopa ma Iosepna aet, na Iosepa ma Mariana kaŋgait.

content: Na Maria ma Iesusa mɨratna meac, na Iesusa ma Karais.

Ainda moca an Abraamna wiwitta muruŋa kɨpca Dewitna wiwitna mɨnna tɨkatnanna, anna parniŋapa mbutremb paurna mɨn, na Dewitna mɨnna tɨkca kɨpca Babilonnanda, minmo tuomb naaŋgɨatna mɨnna, an toco parniŋapa mbutremb paurna mɨn, na Babilonnanda minmo tuomb naaŋgɨa kɨpca Karaisna mɨn toco, anna parniŋapa mbutremb paurna mɨn.

Na Iesus Karaisa mɨratna nininia gaind, mana aemma Maria, mina manmo Iosep laŋgona moca mababuat. Na an mɨnna maniŋa laŋgo ŋgocor ndeacri, mina wattatnanna Maria, Raraŋ Aetaniacna Ŋeroŋ Ratna gargar mbuŋa ma niktan.
Ri, mana kaŋgait Iosep, ma ramoot wandoŋ laŋ tik, ma Mariamo numbir neaŋ narica, mana tɨki mona iroarta moca ma gaind mamoat, ma manmo laŋanna tɨkcarina moca ma ndona iro mamoat.

Ainda moca Iosepa an iroap eacri, Kacoot Raraŋ Aetaniacna mbaiŋna aiŋa morena ŋeroŋa manmo tamram mbuŋ nakɨpca manmo gaind mambopat, “Iosep, Dewitna ŋgamaɨr, u ndona meac aŋgɨca laŋgona kai nanambi teac, u warac, an mooŋnuoca mana nikinik ndeacrenanna, anna Raraŋ Aetaniacna Ŋeroŋ Rat neaŋrina.
Na ma Nuocna mooŋnuoca mɨrnande, te, u mana imo Iesus ŋgacnande, na an ina mɨnɨŋa gaind, ma ndona meikramtaɨrta tɨpemb ŋgorikta makukara mo kecarica, minmo mac nda aŋgɨnande.”
Aintik an kirarira larurinanna, anna Kacootta ndona ramma morina ramootna kamma moi mɨnna tɨkna moca. Na mana ramma morina ramootta gaindopatna,
“Meac ianna ma ramootap ŋgoŋgortanna, ma nik tɨkca nuocna mooŋnuoc ianna mɨrnande. Te, mina manmo Emanuel ŋgacnandet.” Na an ina mɨnɨŋa gaind, “Raraŋ Aetaniaca aiap eacnandet.”
Ri, Iosepa ma ŋgoca maica ŋgepatke, ma an Kacoot Raraŋ Aetaniacna mbaiŋna aiŋa morena ŋeroŋa mbopatna iroa, ma ndona baburina meacmo malaŋgoat.
Ainda moca ma ndona meacapa mba ŋgori, taŋca an mɨn, mana meaca mooŋnuoca mɨratke, Iosepa manmo an i Iesus matɨkat.

footnotes.text: An i Iesus, anna Girikna kam. Na an i Iosua anna Iburuna kam. Na maniŋa mɨnɨŋ kabe. Na an i niŋna mɨnɨŋa gaind, “Kacootta meikramtaɨr mac nda aŋgɨna ramoot.”
